title: The Life-Changing Magic of Tidying Up

recommendations.recommendation: Decide to commit fully to tidying and picture the lifestyle you want first.
recommendations.rationale: A clear vision and firm resolve keep you from giving up.

recommendations.recommendation: Tidy all at once, in one concentrated effort, not a little each day.
recommendations.rationale: Short, complete tidying changes how you think and prevents relapse.

recommendations.recommendation: Discard first, and only then decide where things go.
recommendations.rationale: Storage solutions before discarding just move clutter around.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep only things that spark joy when you hold them.
recommendations.rationale: Choosing what to keep, not what to throw out, builds a home filled only with things you love.
recommendations.argued_against: Keeping things from obligation or fear

recommendations.recommendation: Tidy by category, not by location, starting with clothes, then books, papers, miscellany, and sentimental items.
recommendations.rationale: Gathering all items of one type shows the true volume and trains your sense of joy before harder categories.

recommendations.recommendation: Handle your own things only; do not discard family members' belongings, and do not push tidying on them.
recommendations.rationale: Showing by example works better than forcing, and others' items are theirs to decide.

recommendations.recommendation: Thank items for their service when letting go of them.
recommendations.rationale: Gratitude lets you release things without guilt and teaches you to value what you keep.

recommendations.recommendation: Fold clothes into small rectangles and store them upright so everything is visible.
recommendations.rationale: Upright storage is compact, makes everything visible, and keeps clothes from being crushed.

recommendations.recommendation: Give every item its own place and store things in one spot, with similar items together.
recommendations.rationale: Fixed homes make putting things away easy and prevent rebound clutter.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not buy storage gadgets or stack things; use simple boxes you already have.
recommendations.rationale: Storage experts' tools can hide clutter, and stacking buries things.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not keep items for hypothetical future use, such as papers or freebies you may need someday.
recommendations.rationale: Most 'someday' items are never used, and they burden the present.

recommendations.recommendation: Treat your home as a place to honor your belongings and greet it with a daily routine of care.
recommendations.rationale: Respecting your space and possessions builds a better relationship with them.
